title_zh: 英伟达员工呼吁董事会请回黄仁勋，内网帖收到逾 1600 条评论
content_zh:
据《连线》查阅的内部通信，一位英伟达资深工程师在黄仁勋辞职前通过公司内网「建议箱」发帖，要求董事会先听取员工意见。报道发布时，帖子已有逾 1600 条评论，多数支持黄仁勋复职。还有员工向全公司发邮件，要求董事会解释他的离职经过。

英伟达此前已宣布由首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯担任临时 CEO，董事哈维·琼斯出任董事会主席。董事会正从公司内外遴选正式 CEO。《连线》就员工的呼吁向英伟达和琼斯求证，报道刊发时尚未收到回应。

换帅消息公布前，有网友在 X 上建议马斯克聘用黄仁勋，马斯克回应「那将是我的荣幸」。13 日，他又转发了 a16z 发布的一段有关黄仁勋的对谈片段，只配了一个词「Jensen」。

美东时间 11 月 13 日，英伟达收报每股 162.85 美元，下跌 2.01%，盘中一度跌至 158.39 美元。公司市值约为 3.92 万亿美元，收盘时重新超越微软，位居美股第二，仅次于苹果的约 5.18 万亿美元。

英伟达本周累计下跌 12.7%，市值蒸发超过 5730 亿美元，连续第六周下跌，创下 2012 年以来最长连跌纪录。

🔗 相关阅读（APPSO）：黄仁勋自嘲是「人渣」，英伟达员工集体喊话求回归
title_en: Nvidia Employees Urge Board to Reinstate Jensen Huang Amid Internal Uproar
content_en:
Nvidia employees are speaking out following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, with over 1,600 comments appearing on an internal intranet thread urging the board to bring him back. Staff members have also sent company-wide emails demanding clarity regarding the circumstances surrounding his resignation.

In the interim, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has stepped in as temporary CEO, while board member Harvey Jones takes over as board chairman as the search for a permanent successor continues. Meanwhile, tech figures like Elon Musk have publicly expressed interest in working with Huang.

The leadership upheaval comes amid a sharp downturn in Nvidia’s market performance. The chipmaker's stock dropped 2.01% on November 13, bringing its weekly decline to 12.7%—its longest weekly losing streak since 2012, wiping out over $573 billion in market value despite maintaining a $3.92 trillion market cap.

title_zh: 余承东和张兴海同台发布问界新 M8，重申华为与赛力斯分工
content_zh:
问界新 M8 于 11 月 13 日在重庆赛力斯超级工厂上市。华为终端 BG 董事长余承东与赛力斯集团董事长张兴海同台出席。余承东说，华为主导的工作有赛力斯参与，赛力斯主导的工作也有华为参与。

据鞭牛士现场报道，余承东在会上介绍，华为负责新 M8 的核心技术、产品定义和设计，赛力斯负责工程落地、整车制造及销售服务。双方在 9 月签署了新的五年合作协议，问界仍在鸿蒙智行体系内，并组建专属团队运营。

新 M8 有增程和纯电两种动力，各提供五座和六座布局。新车搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5，全系配备 800V 平台和双腔闭式空气悬架。发布会公布的增程版 CLTC 综合续航最高 1385 公里，纯电版 CLTC 续航最高 800 公里。

🔗 相关阅读：余承东公布华为问界新合作模式！新 M8 同步上市，起售价 37.98 万元
title_en: Huawei and Seres Launch AITO New M8 SUV, Reaffirming Partnership and Division of Roles
content_en:
Huawei and Seres officially launched the new AITO M8 SUV on November 13 at the Seres Super Factory in Chongqing. During the joint event, Huawei Terminal BG Chairman Richard Yu and Seres Group Chairman Zhang Xinghai reaffirmed their close collaboration following the signing of a new five-year partnership agreement in September.

Under the updated division of labor, Huawei takes charge of core technologies, product definition, and vehicle design, while Seres handles engineering implementation, manufacturing, and sales services. The AITO brand will continue to operate under the Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance (HIMA) with a dedicated team.

The new AITO M8 is offered in both Extended-Range Electric Vehicle (EREV) and pure EV variants, with five- and six-seat configurations. Built on an 800V architecture, the SUV features Huawei's Qiankun ADS 5 autonomous driving system and dual-chamber closed air suspension, delivering a maximum CLTC range of up to 1,385 km for the EREV version and 800 km for the pure EV model.

title_zh: DeepSeek 开放 App 工具接口，开发者可接入搜索、文件和语音
content_zh:
DeepSeek 11 月 13 日开放一组应用 API，把官方 App 和网页端使用的联网搜索、文件输入、链接阅读等工具接入现有对话接口。开发者在 V4.1-Flash 的 Messages、Responses 或 Chat Completions 接口启用相应工具后，服务端会处理工具调用，并把结果放回对话上下文。

普通模式可按问题搜索网页或图片，并在回答中附上引用。思考模式可以在多步推理中继续搜索、打开链接。上传 PDF、Office 文档或图片时，接口可提取文本或解析图文混排内容，再交给模型回答。

网页搜索和抓取、图片文字识别、语音识别及语音合成也可单独调用。DeepSeek 同时开源了一个静态聊天页面，用来演示附件、语音和链接阅读，并支持导入 DeepSeek 历史对话。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，DeepSeek 开放全家桶 API，人人都能打造自己的超级 App
title_en: DeepSeek Opens Application APIs for Web Search, File Parsing, and Voice Integration
content_en:
AI developer DeepSeek has officially released a comprehensive set of application APIs, enabling developers to integrate web search, document parsing, and link-reading features directly into their applications via standard chat completion endpoints.

Compatible with the V4.1-Flash model's API interfaces, the new system processes tool calls server-side and integrates the retrieved results back into the conversation context. In standard mode, the model performs web and image searches complete with inline citations, while the multi-step reasoning mode can dynamically search and browse web links during complex thought processes. Additionally, the APIs support text extraction from PDFs, Office documents, and images.

Beyond contextual integrations, capabilities such as web scraping, OCR, speech recognition, and speech synthesis can also be called as standalone services. To assist integration, DeepSeek has open-sourced a static web UI demonstrating features like file attachments, voice interaction, and chat history imports.

title_zh: Microsoft 365 故障仍在恢复，微软将邮件超时窗口延长至 48 小时
content_zh:
Microsoft 365 故障从美国当地时间 11 月 12 日延续至 13 日。微软在 13 日下午的更新中称，部分基础设施已出现早期趋稳迹象，但服务容量尚未恢复正常。为保护积压的邮件，微软将投递超时窗口延长至 48 小时。

此前，部分服务器恢复接收流量后再次失去响应。微软为上游身份验证和路由配置组件应用了补丁，工程团队正逐批卸下流量、重启和修复服务器，再分阶段接回。故障从 Exchange Online 扩展到依赖邮件服务的功能，涉及 Outlook 邮件收发、Teams 日历和会议安排、SharePoint Online 及 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的部分功能。

澳大利亚上拉克伦郡议会称，故障导致部分州政府业务无法在柜台办理，普通缴费仍可受理。菲律宾最高法院表示，邮件回复等工作受到影响。美国商用车公司 Workhorse 将原定 12 日举行的三季度财报电话会推迟到 16 日。
title_en: Microsoft 365 Outage Triggers 48-Hour Email Timeout Extension Amid Global Disruptions
content_en:
Microsoft 365 is working to recover from an extended service outage that began on November 12. While Microsoft reported early signs of infrastructure stabilization on November 13, overall service capacity has not yet returned to normal. To prevent message loss and manage the backing-up queue, Microsoft has temporarily extended the email delivery timeout window to 48 hours.

The outage originated in Exchange Online and expanded to several dependent services, impacting Outlook email functionality, Teams calendar and meeting scheduling, SharePoint Online, and select features in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Engineering teams applied patches to upstream authentication and routing components, and are currently restarting and restoring servers in phased batches to manage traffic safely.

The multi-day disruption has caused widespread real-world impacts. Local government offices in Australia faced counter-service disruptions, the Supreme Court of the Philippines reported delayed email operations, and U.S. commercial vehicle manufacturer Workhorse was forced to postpone its Q3 earnings call to November 16.

title_zh: OpenAI 撤销独立机器人团队，研究人员并入通用模型团队
content_zh:
OpenAI 向《财富》证实，公司已撤销独立机器人团队。机器人研究人员将并入由首席研究官马克·陈领导的研究部门，机器人应用和硬件团队则转入总裁格雷格·布罗克曼负责的应用部门。

OpenAI 表示，研究人员年初曾计划沿着 Sora 等视频生成模型的路线推进机器人研究，随后发现 GPT-6 Astra 等通用模型可以直接用于执行部分机器人任务。公司将机器人研究并入更广泛的模型研发工作，硬件和应用继续由另一部门负责。
title_en: OpenAI Disbands Standalone Robotics Team to Integrate Research into General AI Models
content_en:
OpenAI has confirmed to *Fortune* that it has disbanded its standalone robotics team. Under the reorganization, robotics researchers are being merged into the core research division led by Chief Research Officer Mark Chen, while hardware and applications personnel will move to the applications department under President Greg Brockman.

According to OpenAI, researchers initially intended to advance robotics using video generation models like Sora. However, the company determined that general-purpose models, such as GPT-6 Astra, could directly perform certain robotics tasks. Consequently, OpenAI chose to fold its robotics research directly into its broader AI model development initiatives while keeping hardware and practical applications in a separate division.

title_zh: 两部门公布新型储能方案，提出到 2030 年平均储能约 3 小时
content_zh:
国家发展改革委、国家能源局 11 月 13 日公开《「十五五」新型储能实施方案》，提出到 2030 年全国新型储能装机达到 3 亿千瓦，平均储能时长约 3 小时。其中，可在用电高峰承担保供任务的电网侧独立新型储能规模目标为约 1.4 亿千瓦。

方案提出，在实行清单管理的前提下，建立电网侧独立新型储能的容量电价机制。电力现货市场连续运行后，有序建立可靠容量补偿机制。用电侧则鼓励产业园区和 5G 通信基站等按实际需求配置储能。
title_en: China Unveils 2030 Energy Storage Plan Targeting 300 GW Capacity and 3-Hour Duration
content_en:
China's National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) and the National Energy Administration (NEA) have released the implementation plan for new energy storage under the 15th Five-Year Plan. The document targets a national installed capacity of 300 gigawatts (GW) for new energy storage by 2030, with an average storage duration of approximately three hours.

To ensure power supply during peak demand, the plan sets a target of roughly 140 GW specifically for independent, grid-side new energy storage. China plans to establish a capacity pricing mechanism for grid-side storage managed through official lists, alongside a reliable capacity compensation framework as electricity spot markets achieve continuous operation.

On the demand side, the policy encourages industrial parks, 5G telecommunications base stations, and other commercial users to deploy energy storage systems tailored to their operational needs.

title_zh: LangChain 完成 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，估值 30 亿美元
content_zh:
AI 智能体开发平台 LangChain 宣布完成 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，估值为 30 亿美元。老股东 CapitalG 领投，GIC、DFJ Growth 首次参投，IVP 和 Sapphire Ventures 等老股东跟投。

LangChain 表示，已有逾 7000 家机构使用其 LangSmith 平台。平台支持部署由不同模型驱动的智能体，记录每次运行中的模型和工具调用，并让企业统一管理工具权限和模型预算。LangChain 称，Workday 用这套平台将部署新智能体的时间从五个月缩短到不到一天。公司计划于 11 月 20 日公布 LangSmith 新功能。
title_en: LangChain Secures $300M Series C at $3B Valuation to Expand AI Agent Platform
content_en:
AI agent development platform LangChain has raised $300 million in a Series C funding round, boosting its valuation to $3 billion. The round was led by existing investor CapitalG, with new participation from GIC and DFJ Growth, alongside returning backers IVP and Sapphire Ventures.

According to the company, over 7,000 organizations currently use its LangSmith platform. The tool allows enterprises to deploy multi-model AI agents, track execution logs for model and tool calls, and manage tool permissions and model budgets centrally. Software giant Workday reportedly leveraged the platform to cut its agent deployment time from five months to less than a day.

LangChain plans to announce new features for the LangSmith platform on November 20.

title_zh: 💡 灵光产品经理谈个人 AI 助手：团队开始数用户愿意托管多少件事
content_zh:
蚂蚁集团旗下 AI 应用灵光在 10 月底上线 2.0 版。灵光产品经理寺二近日接受《晚点》采访时说，团队把「托管量」作为衡量个人 AI 助手的核心指标，统计用户交给应用持续跟进的事项。

寺二举例，点一杯咖啡是一次任务，持续盯着机票价格才是一项托管事务。应用在云端持续运行，在价格变动或需要用户作决定时主动提醒。团队也会看提醒发出后用户是否回来，以及用户是否愿意继续补充情况，让助手把事情往下办。

寺二说，目前的托管更多集中在监测和提醒。要让助手进一步完成实际操作，还要打通不同互联网平台的数据和接口。
title_en: Ant Group's AI App Lingguang Shifts Focus to Long-Term Task Delegation Metrics
content_en:
Following the release of version 2.0 in late October, Ant Group's AI app Lingguang is prioritizing "delegation volume" as a key metric for personal AI assistants, measuring how many ongoing tasks users entrust to the application.

In a recent interview, product manager Si Er illustrated the concept by contrasting ordering a coffee—a single task—with continuously tracking flight prices, which represents delegated management. Operating persistently in the cloud, Lingguang sends proactive alerts when prices change or decisions are needed, evaluating user re-engagement and willingness to provide further context to complete actions.

While current delegation capabilities focus primarily on monitoring and notifications, enabling full end-to-end task execution will require deeper integration across data APIs from various internet platforms.

title_zh: 荣耀 700 系列定档 11 月 23 日，背屏可贴 GIF、看通知
content_zh:
荣耀宣布，荣耀 700 系列发布会定于 11 月 23 日 14:30，歌手、演员鞠婧祎担任该系列代言人。系列目前已开放预约。

荣耀公布了背屏的几项玩法：把表情包、GIF 或静态图片拖到背屏，抬手查看通知，以及在背屏上玩小游戏。官方预热还提到骁龙芯片、9000mAh 青海湖电池和 4K 动态照片。
title_en: Honor 700 Series Set for Nov 23 Launch Featuring Interactive Rear Display
content_en:
Honor has officially announced that its Honor 700 series launch event will take place on November 23 at 14:30, featuring singer and actress Ju Jingyi as the brand ambassador. Reservations for the series are now open.

The lineup highlights an interactive rear screen, allowing users to customize the display with GIFs, memes, or static images, quickly check notifications, and play mini-games.

Teasers also reveal that the flagship series will come equipped with Snapdragon processors, a massive 9,000mAh Qinghai Lake battery, and support for 4K dynamic photos.

title_zh: 东风日产 NX7 亮相，车内展示可拆卸磁吸垃圾桶
content_zh:
东风日产在 11 月 13 日的珠海 NISSAN DAY 上展示了插电混动 SUV NX7。发布会现场展示了一款车载磁吸垃圾桶。会场大屏上的演示图把它放在车内的固定位置，清理时可以直接取下。

NX7 属于日产在中国开发的新能源 N 序列。日产在活动预告中把它列为当天全球首秀的车型，此前这一序列已推出纯电轿车 N7 和新能源 SUV NX8。
title_en: Dongfeng Nissan Unveils NX7 Plug-In Hybrid SUV Featuring Magnetic Trash Can
content_en:
Dongfeng Nissan officially showcased its new plug-in hybrid SUV, the NX7, during the NISSAN DAY event in Zhuhai on November 13. A practical interior feature highlighted at the launch was a custom magnetic trash bin designed to lock into a designated spot inside the cabin, allowing easy detachment for cleaning.

The NX7 is part of Nissan's China-developed "N" new energy series. Marked as a global debut during the event, the SUV joins the previously launched N7 all-electric sedan and the NX8 SUV in the brand's growing electrified lineup.

title_zh: 索尼新一代 Walkman 开启国行预售，ZX900 售 10999 元
content_zh:
索尼京东自营旗舰店已上架新一代醇音系列 Walkman。三款机型分别是 NW-WM1ZM3、NW-WM1AM3 和 NW-ZX900。京东商品页显示，NW-ZX900 预售价为 10999 元，11 月 15 日中午结束定金阶段，当天 12:30 开始付尾款。

三款机器均搭载安卓 16，支持 aptX Adaptive 和 LE Audio。索尼在数字放大器中加入了前瞻式噪声整形器。系列中体积较小的 ZX900 用铝合金主机身搭配镀金无氧铜后盖；索尼给出的约 38 小时续航对应原生播放器通过平衡接口播放 96kHz/24bit FLAC 文件的场景。
title_en: Sony Launches Pre-Orders for Next-Gen Walkman Series in China, ZX900 Priced at 10,999 Yuan
content_en:
Sony has opened pre-orders for its latest Signature Series Walkman players on its official JD.com flagship store in China. The new range includes three models: the NW-WM1ZM3, NW-WM1AM3, and NW-ZX900. The NW-ZX900 carries a pre-order price tag of 10,999 yuan, with the deposit phase ending at noon on November 15, immediately followed by final balance payments.

All three audio players run on Android 16 and support aptX Adaptive and LE Audio codecs, featuring an upgraded digital amplifier with a predictive noise shaper. The compact ZX900 combines an aluminum alloy body with a gold-plated oxygen-free copper rear cover, delivering up to 38 hours of battery life when playing high-resolution 96kHz/24bit FLAC files via its balanced headphone jack.

title_zh: 保时捷 CEO 谈 Mission S：瞄准比 911 更高的市场
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，保时捷 CEO 迈克尔·莱特斯 11 月 11 日在柏林的一场汽车行业会议上谈到 Mission S。他说，保时捷想展示消费者能实际感受到的工程创新。他把自家的 Mission S 和特斯拉 Roadster 放在一起谈，认为两款车面向不同的买家。

Mission S 是一款中置发动机概念跑车，保时捷计划把它放在 911 之上。彭博社报道，该车的设计可容纳混动或内燃机动力系统。两款车都在 10 月 15 日公开展示，当时特斯拉演示了利用压缩气体推进器让 Roadster 短暂腾空。
title_en: Porsche CEO Outlines Mission S Concept, Aiming for Segment Above the Iconic 911
content_en:
Porsche CEO Michael Leiters shared insights into the Mission S concept sports car during an automotive conference in Berlin on November 11, Bloomberg reported. Leiters emphasized that Porsche aims to deliver practical engineering innovations that drivers can tangibly experience, adding that the Mission S targets a different audience than Tesla's Roadster.

Positioned above the flagship 911 in Porsche's hierarchy, the Mission S is a mid-engine concept designed to support both hybrid and internal combustion powertrains. Both the Mission S and the Tesla Roadster were publicly showcased on October 15, where Tesla briefly demonstrated compressed-gas thrusters on its vehicle.

title_zh: 虾米音乐关停五年后，阿里上线 AI 写歌应用「快乐虾米」
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，阿里旗下「快乐虾米」11 月 13 日登陆 iOS 和安卓应用商店。输入一段故事、想表达的情绪或指定曲风，应用可以生成带歌词和演唱的完整歌曲，也支持生成纯音乐。

应用里有一个「做同款」入口。用户在音乐信息流刷到喜欢的作品时，可以沿用它的创作思路，再换成自己的故事或主题。界面新闻举例，整理后的聊天记录也可以当作写歌素材，由应用提取内容生成歌词和歌曲。

原来的虾米音乐于 2021 年停止服务。「快乐虾米」由阿里 ATH 团队开发，今年 8 月先推出网页测试版，这次把创作和分享入口带到了手机上。
title_en: Alibaba Launches AI Songwriting App 'Happy Xiami' Years After Shutting Down Music Streamer
content_en:
Alibaba has officially launched an AI-powered songwriting app called "Happy Xiami" on iOS and Android, reviving an iconic music brand years after shutting down its Xiami Music streaming service in 2021.

Developed by Alibaba's ATH team, the app allows users to generate complete tracks—including lyrics, vocals, and instrumental arrangements—by entering a short story, emotional tone, or music genre. It can even extract text from chat logs to automatically generate custom lyrics.

The app features a "Make Similar" option, enabling users to adopt the style or concept of trending community posts while inserting their own stories. Following a web-based beta launched in August, the new mobile release brings full AI music creation and sharing directly to smartphones.

title_zh: 宁德时代发布巧克力电池管家，换电时可查电池健康状况
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，宁德时代 11 月 13 日发布「巧克力电池管家」，把电池检测分到车上和换电站。车端可做 53 项自检，换电站可做 66 项深度检测。

宁德时代承诺，巧克力换电网络内的在网电池可享终身监测、终身质保和免费维修、更换。公司计划到 2027 年累计建成 6000 座巧克力换电站，覆盖 297 座城市。
title_en: CATL Unveils Battery Health Management System for EV Swapping Network
content_en:
Chinese battery giant CATL has launched "Choco-SEB Butler," an intelligent battery health management system tailored for its EV battery-swapping network.

The system splits diagnostic duties between the vehicle and the swapping station. Electric vehicles perform 53 automated self-checks on the go, while swapping stations conduct 66 deep-level diagnostic tests during battery exchanges. CATL promises lifetime monitoring, a lifetime warranty, and free repairs or replacements for all active batteries within its swap network.

To support this ecosystem, CATL plans to build 6,000 Choco-SEB battery swapping stations across 297 cities by 2027.

title_zh: Gemini 接入 Google 钱包，可以整理账单和查找订阅扣款
content_zh:
谷歌开始向美国 Gemini 用户推送 Google 钱包连接功能，覆盖网页版和 Android、iOS 应用。用户主动开启连接后，可在聊天里用「@Google Wallet」查询消费记录，也可选择通过 Plaid 把银行或信用卡账户接入钱包。

Gemini 可根据已有账单生成支出图表，找出跨账户的定期扣款并标注涨价项目，或用去年的旅行、礼物开支辅助制定今年预算。连接权限仅限读取账户数据，用户可在设置里随时断开。
title_en: Google Integrates Gemini AI with Google Wallet to Help Track Expenses and Subscriptions
content_en:
Google has begun rolling out a Google Wallet integration for US-based Gemini users across web, Android, and iOS platforms.

Once opted in, users can type "@Google Wallet" in Gemini chats to query transaction history or link bank and credit card accounts via Plaid. Gemini can synthesize this data to generate spending charts, identify recurring subscription charges across accounts, highlight price increases, and help create budgets based on historical spending.

Google noted that the integration operates on read-only permissions, and users can disconnect the service at any time through their settings.

title_zh: 腾讯混元发布 Hy Realtime，元宝语音通话可以点歌、联网搜索
content_zh:
腾讯混元 11 月 13 日发布实时语音模型 Hy Realtime，已接入元宝语音通话和腾讯客服。更新到最新版元宝后，可在语音通话中选择「初语」音色体验。腾讯云计划近期开放 API。

新模型能在通话中根据上下文判断是否需要联网搜索，也能结合前面的对话理解用户说到一半的句子或临时改口。回答时，模型可以一边生成文字一边合成语音，减少开口前的等待。

演唱能力由混元与腾讯音乐 TME 灵音 AI 团队联合开发。点歌时可以组合歌手、曲风、语种和发行年份，比如请它挑一首 2010 年至 2020 年间发行的英文民谣并演唱。
title_en: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy Realtime Voice Model with Singing and Web Search Capabilities
content_en:
Tencent Hunyuan officially launched its real-time voice model, Hy Realtime, on November 13. The model has already been integrated into Yuanbao's voice calling feature and Tencent Customer Service, with plans for an API release on Tencent Cloud in the near future. Users can experience the new technology by updating Yuanbao to the latest version and selecting the "Chuyu" voice persona.

Hy Realtime enhances conversational AI by dynamically determining when web searches are needed based on context. It can also follow complex dialogue nuances, such as mid-sentence interruptions or sudden changes of mind. To minimize latency, the model generates text and synthesizes speech simultaneously, significantly cutting down waiting times before responding.

Additionally, the model features advanced singing capabilities developed in collaboration with Tencent Music Entertainment's (TME) Lingyin AI team. Users can request songs by specifying criteria such as artist, genre, language, and release year—for instance, asking it to select and perform an English folk song released between 2010 and 2020.

title_zh: Thinking Machines 开放 Inkling 2 Small 模型权重，可自行部署
content_zh:
Thinking Machines Lab 将 Inkling 2 Small 的模型权重上传至 Hugging Face，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。该模型于 11 月 5 日公布，这次开放下载后，开发者可在自有环境部署，也可以通过 Together、Fireworks 等平台调用。

Inkling 2 Small 是一个支持图像输入的混合专家模型，总参数 5940 亿，每次推理激活 170 亿。模型支持调节推理投入，也已接入 vLLM、SGLang 等推理框架。
title_en: Thinking Machines Open-Sources Inkling 2 Small Weights for Self-Deployment
content_en:
Thinking Machines Lab has uploaded the model weights for Inkling 2 Small to Hugging Face under the open-source Apache 2.0 license. First announced on November 5, the model can now be self-deployed by developers in local environments or accessed via platforms like Together and Fireworks.

Inkling 2 Small is a vision-capable Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model featuring 594 billion total parameters, with 17 billion activated per inference run. The model supports adjustable inference compute investment and is already integrated with popular inference frameworks, including vLLM and SGLang.

title_zh: 肯德基员工称备货系统在打烊前派单，要后厨再烤 17 只鸡
content_zh:
据新浪财经报道，多位肯德基一线员工称，门店使用 EPQC 备货系统后，屏幕下发的制作任务有时与实际需求不符。一名员工说，所在门店晚上 11 点打烊，系统在晚上 9 点半还要求后厨再烤 17 只全鸡。

过去，负责协调供餐的总配岗位会看现场库存和订单，直接告诉后厨做多少。员工说，系统现在会结合库存和售卖节奏派单，忙时来不及修正库存，屏幕上可能出现负库存，继而触发新的制作任务。部分门店为避免备货过量，已重新用口头沟通安排出餐。肯德基客服向新浪财经表示，相关情况需要后台核实。
title_en: KFC Employees Report Flaws in Automated Food Prep System Ahead of Store Closings
content_en:
KFC front-line staff have voiced frustration over the automated EPQC inventory system, reporting that its production orders frequently mismatch actual store demands. In one instance, a staff member revealed that the system instructed the kitchen to roast 17 whole chickens at 9:30 PM, despite the store closing at 11:00 PM.

Previously, dedicated food coordinators managed prep orders manually based on real-time stock and foot traffic. Under the new system, orders are dispatched automatically by tracking inventory and sales pace. However, during peak hours, staff often lack the time to manually update inventory counts, causing the system to display "negative stock" and trigger unnecessary prep tasks.

To prevent excessive food waste, some store locations have bypassed the digital system and returned to verbal coordination. In response, KFC customer service stated that the situation is currently under internal verification.

title_zh: 大疆将从 11 月 18 日起调整部分产品建议零售价
content_zh:
大疆在 11 月 13 日发布说明，将从 11 月 18 日零时起调整部分产品的建议零售价。大疆把这次调价归因于半导体、存储等多项关键零部件成本持续上涨。涉及哪些型号、调整后的价格是多少，将在 DJI 官方商城对应商品详情页展示。

调价消息最早出现在部分授权门店。11 月 10 日，界面新闻就 Osmo Pocket 系列的涨价消息询问大疆京东自营旗舰店，客服当时表示尚未收到调价通知。大疆随后发出的这份说明，首次明确了部分产品调价的生效时间。
title_en: DJI to Adjust Prices on Select Products Starting November 18
content_en:
DJI announced on November 13 that it will adjust the suggested retail prices for select products starting at midnight on November 18. The company attributed the price revisions to the continuous cost increases of key components, including semiconductors and memory chips.

While rumors of price hikes—particularly concerning the Osmo Pocket series—had been circulating at authorized retail stores earlier this month, DJI's statement officially confirms the effective date. The specific models affected and their updated prices will be published directly on the product pages of DJI's official online store.

title_zh: 星图数据：双 11 电商销售额达 17764 亿元，即时零售增长 33%
content_zh:
星图数据 11 月 12 日发布的监测报告显示，今年双 11 全网电商销售额达 17764 亿元，同比增长 4.8%。这一口径涵盖综合电商、即时零售和社区团购。三类渠道里，即时零售增幅最高，销售额同比增长 33%；综合电商增长 3.7%，社区团购下滑 7.4%。

大促期间，平台也在卖上门服务。据第一财经报道，京东双 11 期间产生了超 3 亿笔服务订单。京东披露，家政多次卡保洁服务成交额同比增长超过 550%，宠物居室除毛服务同比增长 46 倍。
title_en: China's Singles' Day E-Commerce Sales Hit 1.78 Trillion Yuan as Instant Retail Surges 33%
content_en:
China's Singles' Day shopping festival generated 1.7764 trillion yuan (approx. $245 billion) in total e-commerce sales, marking a 4.8% year-on-year growth, according to monitoring data released by Syntun on November 12. The figures encompass traditional e-commerce platforms, instant retail, and community group buying.

Among the channels, instant retail posted the strongest performance with a 33% year-on-year growth. Traditional e-commerce grew by 3.7%, while community group buying experienced a 7.4% decline.

Doorstep service offerings also proved popular during the shopping surge. JD.com reported over 300 million service orders, highlighted by a 550% year-on-year increase in recurring home cleaning subscriptions and a 46-fold jump in pet hair removal services.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜用 AirPods 充电盒控制 Mac 光标
content_zh:
开源项目 AirPointer 演示了一种操作 Mac 的方法。把 AirPods 放回充电盒并合上盖子，转动盒子就能移动光标，轻拍盒子正面则相当于点击。第一次使用时，应用会让用户依次指向屏幕上的三个点来校准。

应用通过蓝牙读取耳机的运动数据，把它换算成光标的位置。作者用一副 AirPods Pro 3 和一台运行 macOS 26 的 Apple 芯片 Mac 测试。

连接会短暂打断耳机音频，一次会话在合盖后约半小时结束。项目页也提醒，结束会话会消耗充电盒中存储的诊断数据。
title_en: Open-Source AirPointer Project Turns AirPods Case into a Mac Cursor Controller
content_en:
An open-source project named AirPointer has introduced a novel way to control a Mac using an AirPods charging case. By placing the AirPods inside the closed case, users can rotate the case to move the screen cursor and tap the front of the case to register clicks. The app uses a quick three-point target screen calibration upon first setup.

The tool operates by reading motion data from the earbuds via Bluetooth and mapping it to cursor coordinates on macOS. 

However, the utility comes with a few caveats: connecting temporarily interrupts earbud audio playback, sessions naturally time out roughly 30 minutes after closing the lid, and ending a session clears diagnostic data stored within the charging case.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《海上钢琴师》4K 修复版重回内地影院
content_zh:
孤儿 1900 在往返欧美的邮轮上长大，从未踏上陆地。他学会了弹钢琴，也靠演奏认识一批又一批上船的旅客。一位爵士乐手特意上船挑战他，两个钢琴家在同一架琴前展开较量。

《海上钢琴师》由朱塞佩·托纳多雷执导，蒂姆·罗斯饰演 1900，恩尼奥·莫里科内为影片作曲。4K 修复版于 11 月 13 日起在中国内地院线重映。影片在豆瓣获 9.3 分。
title_en: Weekend Movie Guide: 'The Legend of 1900' 4K Restoration Returns to Chinese Theaters
content_en:
Giuseppe Tornatore’s cinematic classic *The Legend of 1900* has returned to mainland Chinese theaters in a newly restored 4K edition. Holding an impressive 9.3 rating on Douban, the acclaimed film continues to captivate audiences with Ennio Morricone's iconic score and Tim Roth's memorable starring performance.

The story follows 1900, an orphan raised entirely aboard a transatlantic cruise ship who grows into a musical prodigy without ever setting foot on dry land. His quiet, sea-bound life takes a dramatic turn when a famous jazz musician boards the ship to challenge him to an intense, high-stakes piano duel.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《市场赢家》：一张门票是怎么分到你手里的
content_zh:
抢演唱会门票、排餐厅候补、给想上的学校填志愿，都会遇到同一个问题：当想要的人比名额多，谁来决定先给谁？经济学家贾德·凯斯勒在《市场赢家》里拆解了几种常见的分配办法，包括先到先得、排队、抽签，以及按个人偏好匹配。

书里既谈参与者怎么做决定，也谈规则制定者要付出什么代价。比如餐厅发放订位时，先到先得让熟悉放号时间的人占优，候补和抽签则各有成本。凯斯勒把这些日常例子和市场设计研究放在一起，讨论公平、效率与激励如何相互牵制。

简体中文版由崔传刚译，中信出版集团于 2026 年 10 月出版。纸书在京东中信出版社自营店有售。
title_en: Book Recommendation: 'Market Winners' Explores the Hidden Logic of Resource Allocation
content_en:
Whether securing concert tickets, joining a restaurant waitlist, or applying to top universities, we regularly face the same dilemma: when demand far exceeds supply, who decides who gets what? In *Market Winners*, economist Judd Kessler breaks down common allocation methods, including first-come-first-served systems, queues, lotteries, and preference matching.

The book analyzes decision-making from the perspective of both participants and rule-makers. Blending everyday examples with market design research, Kessler illustrates how fairness, efficiency, and incentives constantly interplay and trade off against one another.

Translated into Simplified Chinese by Cui Chuangang, the book was published by CITIC Publishing Group in October 2026.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版
content_zh:
重回水之神殿时，林克可以用方向键快速穿脱重铁靴，再用右摇杆转动镜头，查看不同水位下的通路。

IGN 中国给 Switch 2 版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》打出 10 分，尤其肯定独立跳跃、冲刺和道具快捷切换对旧迷宫探索的改善。评测也指出，部分谜题的提示更显眼，水之神殿的小钥匙有所减少，解谜门槛随之降低。

任天堂以 1998 年的原作为基础重新制作了这一版。玩家仍要在少年与成年两个时代之间往返，利用各自可用的道具推进冒险。重制版更新了场景和管弦乐配乐，扩写了角色对白，并为过场动画加入配音。

游戏已于 2026 年 11 月 5 日登陆 Nintendo Switch 2。玩家还可以对着主机麦克风哼唱林克学过的旋律，游戏中的林克会用时之笛把它吹出来。
title_en: Game Recommendation: 'The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time' Remake Earns Perfect Scores on Switch 2
content_en:
Nintendo released a ground-up remake of the 1998 classic *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* on Nintendo Switch 2. IGN China awarded the game a perfect 10/10 rating, highlighting major quality-of-life upgrades such as dedicated jump and sprint mechanics, full right-stick camera controls, and instant item switching that modernize dungeon exploration.

The remake enriches Link's legendary journey across two eras with remastered visuals, an orchestral soundtrack, expanded dialogue, and fully voiced cutscenes. Puzzle design has also been smoothed out, easing frustration in notorious areas like the Water Temple by offering clearer hints and streamlined navigation.

Adding a novel interactive touch, players can now hum learned melodies directly into the console's microphone, prompting Link to play the corresponding tunes on his Ocarina.
